name: Kohler C1 Indoor Sauna Kit
description: Kohler C1 Indoor Sauna Kit, Up to 5-People The Kohler C1 Indoor Sauna is designed for both freestanding and alcove installation, providing flexibility for your sauna’s location. Constructed out of premium Scandinavian spruce with tempered glass door and windows. The Kohler C1 Indoor Sauna features a Graphite Grey wood interior and exterior that exudes a welcoming, warm atmosphere. An obeche wood bench and matching backrest with 2700k warm white indirect lighting positioned behind it provides a comfortable sauna experience. The tempered glass door and windows, along with mineral wool insulation and rubber seals, provide excellent heat retention. The C1 Indoor Sauna includes a freestanding FERO Sauna Heater, along with Sauna Stones and Heater Guard. A digital control panel mounted externally provides easy access to sauna temperature, session time, and backrest lighting. The C1 Indoor Sauna is also designed for both freestanding and alcove installation, providing flexibility for your sauna’s location. Installation is available. Assembly only, electrical not included. If your item(s) do arrive damaged please send photos to customercare@nordicasauna.com and we will process an insurance claim on your behalf.
